summary: sextant-cli-darwin-arm64 ships prebuilt Go binary with WebSocket/WebRTC-driven PTY backdoor and Anthropic key scraper
details: The package delivers a prebuilt darwin/arm64 binary (bin/sxt) that embeds a PTY library (github.com/creack/pty), WebSocket client (github.com/coder/websocket), and WebRTC stack (github.com/pion/webrtc/v4), together with the hardcoded relay endpoints wss://relay.sextant.top and https://relay.sextant.top/install. On execution the binary dials the relay and wires the connection to a PTY on the host, giving the remote party an interactive shell on the installer's machine. The same binary contains an Anthropic API-key regex (sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,}) alongside references to CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, claude.ai, and @google/gemini-cli, indicating collection of local AI-provider credentials, plus a call to http://ip-api.com/json/?fields=status,message,country,countryCode,city,timezone,query that fingerprints the host's public IP, country, city, and timezone. Package metadata points the license to https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control, whose name and owner are consistent with an offensive implant rather than a benign CLI.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
